headlines.text: S&P 500 futures rise ~0.7% and Nasdaq-100 futures gain 0.6% as Wall Street heads into Friday's shortened Black Friday session, capping a volatile holiday week
Nvidia's China-chip scandal widens as general counsel Tim Teter agrees to closed-door House testimony Dec. 2, a day after ousted CEO Jensen Huang's own Dec. 1 session
SEC opens civil probe into whether Nvidia misled investors following Jensen Huang's abrupt Nov. 12 resignation as CEO
California AG Rob Bonta's office subpoenas Nvidia, escalating from inquiry to formal probe of China-spy-tied disclosures around Huang's ouster
Commerce and Justice Departments confirm criminal investigation into Nvidia partner Megaspeed over suspected chip-smuggling to China
Traders now price roughly 90% odds the Fed delivers a quarter-point hike at the Dec. 9 FOMC meeting
Fed's preferred inflation gauge cools to 2.7% core PCE in October from 2.8%, modest relief before the December rate decision
